name: sprites-batch1
goal: 1차 스프라이트 배치 — 순환 앞쪽 테마(김밥·카페·초밥) 인게임 오브젝트 12종. 골든 레퍼런스(tone-a-pop-comic, ADR-008) 앵커. 0.5초 판독성이 최우선 검수 기준.
style: bold clean dark outlines, vibrant high-saturation colors, energetic comic cartoon sticker style, playful slightly exaggerated chunky proportions, flat cel shading with one simple gloss highlight
common: single centered object, isolated on a fully transparent background, no text, no watermark, no logo, 1024x1024 PNG with alpha, generous ~12% margin, slight 3/4 top-down angle, instantly readable silhouette even at small size
